bingo.obj.craft.crafting_table.desc: Four planks. The very first step.
bingo.obj.craft.iron_pickaxe.desc: Requires three iron ingots and two sticks.
bingo.obj.craft.enchanting_table.desc: Obsidian, diamonds and a book. A long chain.
bingo.obj.find.dirt.desc: Any dirt in your inventory counts.
bingo.obj.find.iron_ingot.desc: Smelt, trade or loot — obtaining is what counts.
bingo.obj.find.ender_pearl.desc: From an Enderman, or from a piglin trade.
bingo.obj.find.ancient_debris.desc: Nether only, below Y=22. No recipe: JEI won't help.
bingo.obj.kill.creeper.desc: Melee, bow or fall damage — the credit follows the attacker.
bingo.obj.kill.wither.desc: Three skulls and four soul sand. Then survive.
bingo.obj.death.fall.desc: Cheap in points, expensive in gear.
bingo.obj.death.lava.desc: Everything you carry burns with you.
bingo.obj.death.sonic_boom: Die to a Warden's sonic boom
bingo.obj.death.sonic_boom.desc: Find the Deep Dark. Make noise. Do not run.
bingo.obj.action.sleep_in_bed.desc: Wool, planks, and a safe spot.
bingo.obj.action.enter_nether.desc: Ten obsidian and a flint and steel.
bingo.obj.action.kill_dragon.desc: The whole game, on one tile.
bingo.message.draw: Draw — no team completed a line.
bingo.command.error.not_enough_teams: At least two teams with one player each are required.
bingo.command.error.wrong_phase: Not possible in the current phase (%s).
bingo.obj.craft.torch.desc: Coal and a stick. Shift-clicking counts for the full stack.
bingo.obj.find.oak_log.desc: Any wood type — the tag accepts them all.
bingo.obj.kill.chicken.desc: The easiest tile on the board.
bingo.obj.death.cactus.desc: You have to find a desert first.
bingo.obj.craft.iron_sword.desc: Two ingots. Competes with the pickaxe for the same ore.
bingo.obj.craft.shield.desc: Six planks and one iron ingot.
bingo.obj.find.gold_ingot.desc: Mine it, or trade with a piglin.
bingo.obj.kill.skeleton.desc: The tag also accepts strays and wither skeletons.
bingo.obj.death.explosion.desc: A creeper, or your own TNT. Both count.
bingo.obj.craft.golden_apple.desc: Eight gold ingots around an apple.
bingo.obj.craft.brewing_stand.desc: Needs a blaze rod. Nether first.
bingo.obj.kill.enderman.desc: Fight them in a two-block-high corridor.
bingo.obj.death.wither_effect.desc: A wither rose is the cheapest route.
bingo.obj.craft.netherite_pickaxe.desc: Four ancient debris, four gold, a diamond pickaxe, a smithing table.
bingo.obj.find.nether_star.desc: Means killing the Wither. There is no other way.
bingo.obj.kill.elder_guardian.desc: Find an ocean monument, then survive Mining Fatigue.
bingo.obj.action.enter_end.desc: Twelve eyes of ender, and a stronghold to find.
bingo.obj.death.arrow.desc: From a skeleton, another player, anything
bingo.obj.find.axolotlbucket: Obtain an Axolotl in a Bucket
